top_choice_rationale: P001 (Holst, Drucker, Mojsov) rests on a specific, independently confirmed discovery chain: proglucagon processing and the incretin effect, the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, and receptor and tissue biology. Large randomized trials in type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal outcomes confirm the mechanism, so maturity is not in doubt. A physiology-anchored citation with the therapies as consequence makes the exclusion of Knudsen a principled boundary. The residual cost is that Mojsov's priority against early peptide workers is unverified from the supplied record. I judge that cost smaller than awarding nothing.
